bibliographic-data.invention-title: APPAREILS DE SUPPORT DE PERSONNE AYANT DES CARACTÉRISTIQUES DE THÉRAPIE D'EXERCICE
PERSON SUPPORT APPARATUSES HAVING EXERCISE THERAPY FEATURES

abstract.p: A person support apparatus is disclosed. The person support apparatus comprises a base frame; an upper frame supported by the base frame; a deck supported by the upper frame and comprising sections movable to a plurality of articulated positions including a chair configuration; a mattress supported by the deck; a pair of side rails adjacent sides of the mattress, each side rail of the pair of side rails comprising a section configured to be grasped by a hand of a user; a footboard adjacent an end of the mattress, the footboard configured to engage feet of the user; and a reduced friction mechanism configured to be positioned on the mattress and under a user, the reduced friction mechanism permitting sliding of the user relative to the deck.
